# ankra_cloudflare_dns_record (Resource)

A DNS record in a Cloudflare zone, written through a connected `ankra_cloudflare_credential`. Find zone ids with the `ankra_cloudflare_domains` data source. The counterpart of `ankra org cloudflare add|update|delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cloudflare_domains" "main" {
  credential_name = ankra_cloudflare_credential.main.name
}

locals {
  example_zone_id = one([for domain in data.ankra_cloudflare_domains.main.domains : domain.id if domain.name == "example.com"])
}

resource "ankra_cloudflare_dns_record" "www" {
  credential_name = ankra_cloudflare_credential.main.name
  zone_id         = local.example_zone_id
  name            = "www"
  record_type     = "CNAME"
  content         = "ingress.k8s.example.com"
  proxied         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) What the record points at.
- `name` (String) Record name: a label such as `www` (qualified with the zone) or the full name. Changing it replaces the record.
- `record_type` (String) `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `TXT`, `MX` or `NS`. Changing it replaces the record.
- `zone_id` (String) Cloudflare zone id. Changing it replaces the record.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment stored on the record. Defaults to `Managed by Ankra`, which the platform stamps on a record written without one.
- `credential_name` (String) Cloudflare credential to write with. Unset uses the organisation's only Cloudflare credential. Changing it replaces the record.
- `priority` (Number) Priority of an `MX` record. Once set it can be changed but not removed.
- `proxied` (Boolean) Route the record through Cloudflare's proxy (`A`, `AAAA` and `CNAME` only). Defaults to `false`.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds, 60 to 86400, or `1` for automatic. Defaults to `1`; a proxied record is always automatic.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) Full name of the record.
- `id` (String) Cloudflare's id for the record.
- `managed_by` (String) `ankra` when the record carries the platform's comment, otherwise `external`.
- `zone_name` (String) Name of the zone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Cloudflare records are imported by zone_id/record_id, or
# credential_name/zone_id/record_id when the organisation has several
# Cloudflare credentials.
terraform import ankra_cloudflare_dns_record.www cloudflare-main/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/372e67954025e0ba6aaa6d586b9e0b59
```
